about: VisionClaw's fourth evaluation set, written on 2026-11-19 before the understanding grammar (claw/understand.py) was written and before anything was run on it. It asks for the same jobs in casual, roundabout and slangy words, the way people really talk, to measure whether VisionClaw understands different ways of asking. Never tune on it without writing a fifth. Same form as requests.json.
